translations.web: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive plants around your table.
translations.bsb: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
translations.kjv: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
translations.asv: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, Round about thy table.
